{{Quote|Ahh&hellip; The ceaseless throng of teeming inhumanity. Doesn't it just shake the permafrost off your heartstrings, Princess?|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="The Pandora Effect">{{StoryCite|story=The Pandora Effect|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151}}</ref>}}
'''Permafrost''' was a kind of surface found on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with freezing temperatures.

The [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] assigned to [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] carried special [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that ensured Hoth's permafrost could support the larger [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]].<ref name="Titanium">''[[Star Wars: Titanium Series]]'' AT-ST (Hoth)</ref>

[[Alexsandr Badure|Alexsandr "Trooper" Badure]] commented that the commandant at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] turned "cold as permafrost" after being corrected by [[Cadet/Legends|Cadet]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] prior to a training mission.<ref name="HLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>
